address: Laan Van Meerdervoort 6, The Hague, 2517 AJ, Netherlands
bio: With its parquet floors, marble tables and walls adorned with works of art, the luxurious Villa Coucou, one of The Hague’s shining culinary lights, is not short on style! Enjoy a cocktail at the bar or in the wine cellar (which even has space for a game of boules!) before savouring the revisited classics of French cuisine. The chef here is passionate about top-quality ingredients and enjoys toying with intense aromas and light textures....
